decisions.reason: The required solenoid valve and station-button control hardware are already represented by the candidate's message-53 MODIFY, with no additional BOM change necessarily entailed.
The candidate's existing message-53 MODIFY already incorporates the accepted solenoid placement and button-controlled dispensing path into the system layout.
The accepted solenoid actuation mechanism and press-to-open, release-to-stop behavior are already fully represented by the candidate's message-53 MODIFY.
The candidate's message-53 MODIFY already records the gravity-fed solenoid path and absence of retained matcha in the spout or tubing; the wiring-plan change entails no further pour-quality update.
Adding solenoid-control wiring coverage does not change the existing requirement to power the prototype from a standard 120V wall outlet.
The accepted valve-control approach does not alter the requirement that the bottom bowl seal prevent liquid from reaching the electronics.
The source decision does not change the independently stated requirement to minimize splashing during mixing and use.
The solenoid and station-button wiring coverage does not necessarily modify the unit's structural support or operational-stability requirements.
The candidate already has a complete message-53 MODIFY recording the accepted rendering-matched, custom-fabricated stainless-steel spout, followed by RESUME; no additional modification is required.
The accepted solenoid approach does not replace or narrow the existing requirement that the spout remain removable or easy to flush and clean.
